morphology.formula: ber- + sentuhan → bersentuhan；更底层：ber- + sentuh + -an → bersentuhan
morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包的直接基形 sentuhan；底层词根是 sentuh。整体 ber-...-an 表示相互接触；ber- 的 /r/ 与词根首音 /s/ 均保留，不发生鼻音替换。

word_family.gloss: 相互接触的过程或状态

senses.zh_definition: 彼此碰到、轻微相碰或处于接触状态。
senses.en_definition: To touch one another or come into slight contact.
senses.ms_definition: Saling mengenai atau bergesel sedikit antara satu sama lain.
senses.nuances: 侧重双方或两物之间发生接触，未必出于故意，也不必涉及人。不同于主动及物的 menyentuh。[DBP：bersentuhan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=bersentuhan)。

collocations.en: come into contact with the skin

senses.zh_definition: 与某事相联系、有关联或涉及相邻的议题。
senses.en_definition: To relate to or have a connection with something.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai kaitan atau sangkut paut dengan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，常用 bersentuhan dengan；多见于论述，通常比 berkaitan dengan 更具文辞色彩。[DBP：bersentuhan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=bersentuhan)。

collocations.en: have a connection with cultural questions

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 设备检查报告
dual_scenarios.ms: Pemeriksaan mendapati bahawa kedua-dua komponen itu bersentuhan apabila penutup mesin ditutup.
dual_scenarios.zh: 检查发现，机器盖合上时，那两个部件会相互接触。
dual_scenarios.en: The inspection found that the two components touch when the machine cover is closed.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友谈论拥挤的轻快铁
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tadi kat LRT sesak sangat, bahu kami sampai bersentuhan.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Keadaan di dalam LRT tadi sangat sesak sehingga bahu kami bersentuhan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才轻快铁里太挤了，我们的肩膀都碰在一起了。
dual_scenarios.en: The LRT was so packed earlier that our shoulders were touching.
spoken_features: kat 是 di 或 dekat 的口语形式，此处表示地点。
sampai 在口语中可引出结果，对应 sehingga。
口语可省略 keadaan 和 di dalam 等可由情境补足的成分。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tadi kat LRT sesak sangat, bahu kami sampai bersentuhan.
messages.ms_standard: Keadaan di dalam LRT tadi sangat sesak sehingga bahu kami bersentuhan.
messages.zh: 刚才轻快铁里挤得不行，我们的肩膀都碰在一起了。
messages.en: The LRT was so packed earlier that our shoulders were touching.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Patutlah kau lambat. Aku dah sampai kat kafe.
messages.ms_standard: Patutlah kamu lewat. Saya sudah tiba di kafe.
messages.zh: 难怪你迟到了。我已经到咖啡馆了。
messages.en: That explains why you're late. I'm already at the café.

etymology.historical_story: Bersentuhan shows how Malay builds relationships into a verb. Sentuh supplies the idea of touch, while the ber-...-an formation presents contact between participants. Its dictionary meanings also move beyond the physical: matters can be connected without objects meeting. This gives learners a concrete bridge from shoulders touching in a crowd to ideas intersecting in an essay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个 sentuh“碰触点”画在一起：bersentuhan＝双方碰到；抽象时就是两件事有关联。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述身体接触时，这个词本身中性；接触是否合宜取决于个人意愿、关系及文化或宗教习惯，不应仅凭族群作判断。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于拥挤交通、物体接触及学术论述。与不熟悉的人互动时，先观察对方是否愿意握手；点头和微笑也能表达礼貌。
